text:
SUPPLY AGREEMENT (DRAFT v3, FICTIONAL DEMO DOCUMENT)
Supplier: PT Arunika Bahan Baku. Buyer: CV Maju.
1. Goods: steel chair frames, grade SPCC, powder coated.
2. Volume: buyer commits to 6,000 frames over 12 months, minimum 450 frames per month.
3. Unit price: IDR 412,000 per frame, fixed for 12 months.
4. Payment: 30 days after delivery.
5. Late delivery penalty: 0.5% of the order value per day, capped at 5%.
6. Price review: supplier may raise the price if steel index rises more than 8%.
7. Exclusivity: buyer may not buy frames from another supplier during the term.
8. Term: 12 months, renewing automatically unless cancelled 60 days before the end.
